newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline flat, barges trade at $204-$205.50.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline flat, barges trade at $204-$205.50.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices held stable on Wednesday after Tuesday's sharp falls and dealers said supplies were relatively tight.

Eurograde barges traded at $204 and $205 fob Amsterdam-Rotterdam for storage-origin material while running refinery product changed hands at $205 and $205.50, around a dollar above the value of June swaps.
A French refiner was heard to have bought a 10,000 tonne cargo of Eurograde gasoline at a quotes-related price but no more details were known.
Arbitrage opportunities to the United States were not considered workable because of the lack of cargo-sized pieces in Northwest Europe, and also due to the strongly backwardated market in the U.S.
Eurograde cargoes were pegged notionally around $213/$216 cif Hamburg, but this market was thinly discussed.
